provenance.paper_title: video-SALMONN S: Memory-Enhanced Streaming Audio-Visual LLM

representation_paths.memory_component: TTT_MEM fast weights W_t that absorb streamed audio-visual chunks into long-term memory held in model parameters

evidence.section: Full paper: Sec. 3.1 Test-time training memory (TTT_MEM)
evidence.paraphrase: The layer computes (Z_t, W_t) = TTT_MEM(X_t, X_{t-T}, W_{t-1}); the fast weights W_t are updated at streaming time by a gradient step W_t = W_{t-1} - eta * grad l(X_t, X_{t-T}; W_{t-1}) on a reconstruction loss (Eq. 2) plus a long-span prediction loss (Eq. 3) that 'encourages retention of information relevant across distant timestamps'. The abstract states the model 'continuously transforms short-term multimodal representations into long-term memory embedded in model parameters', so history persists only inside the weights and no source frames or audio are recoverable.

representation_paths.memory_component: fixed-size bank of N multimodal memory tokens Z~_t carried recurrently across streaming chunks

evidence.paraphrase: A fixed-size sequence of N memory tokens (16k default, up to 128k) persists across chunks; incoming tokens Z_t are merged with the previous bank Z~_{t-1} and the budget is held by discarding the most cosine-similar adjacent token pairs. This bank is a deliberate recurrent multimodal latent state supplied to the LLM at later chunks, supporting streams of over three hours at 11 FPS.

representation_paths.memory_component: prompt-dependent compressed KV-cache used for modality-aware memory reading

evidence.section: Full paper: Sec. 3.3 Modality-aware memory reading
evidence.paraphrase: At read time the retained per-layer key/value cache is compressed in a prompt-dependent way: the top-M tokens per layer by attention score against the current question are kept with their relative positions preserved, so which cached audio-visual encodings reach the answer depends on the query.

During streaming inference the fast-weight memory is revised by an explicit gradient-descent step per chunk on reconstruction and long-span prediction objectives; the memory content (weights) changes while the update rule, span T = 2 and learning rate eta remain fixed.

New chunk tokens are merged into the persistent memory-token bank and the bank is held at its budget by discarding the K highest-similarity adjacent token pairs, a fixed deduplication rule applied at streaming time.

evidence.section: Full paper: Sec. 3.3 Modality-aware memory reading
evidence.paraphrase: Prompt-dependent KV-cache compression drops all but the top-M attention-scored tokens per layer at inference time under a fixed selection rule.

derived.hybrid_relation: The TTT fast-weight long-term memory, the recurrent multimodal memory-token bank, and the prompt-compressed modality-native KV cache are jointly supplied to the LLM when answering at a given point in the stream.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review: although the mechanism is called test-time training, what changes at deployment is memory content (fast weights W_t and the memory-token bank) under a gradient rule whose form, span and learning rate are fixed. The TTT_MEM projection parameters theta are learned in a two-stage offline scheme (Sec. 3.2, Figure 3: stage 1 at 1024 frames, stage 2 frozen theta at 2048 frames) and are frozen at test time; no write, maintenance or retrieval policy is revised from deployment feedback, so T3 does not apply.
Deliberate recurrent memory carried across streaming chunks is counted as T2 per the guide, distinct from ordinary prompt history.
